sentences.cn_text: 自2010年代Airbnb等网站兴起以来,整个新英格兰地区的社区一直在试图规范短期租赁。
sentences.en_text: Communities throughout New England have been attempting to regulate short-term rentals since sites like Airbnb took off in the 2010s.

sentences.cn_text: 如今,在房价创历史新高、库存创历史新低的情况下,这种监管变得更加紧迫,尤其是在那些担心开发商会大量收购住房、在短期租赁市场上牟取暴利的人群中。
sentences.en_text: Now, with record-high home prices and historically low inventory, there’s an increased urgency in such regulation, particularly among those who worry that developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market.

sentences.cn_text: 在新罕布什尔州,租赁空置率已降至1%以下,住房倡导者担心不受监管的短期租赁将进一步加剧本已紧张的市场压力。
sentences.en_text: In New Hampshire, where the rental vacancy rate has dropped below 1 percent, housing advocates fear unchecked short-term rentals will put further pressure on an already strained market.

sentences.cn_text: 州立法机构最近否决了一项法案,该法案原本会禁止城镇制定限制短期租赁的法规。
sentences.en_text: The State Legislature recently voted against a bill that would’ve made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.

sentences.cn_text: 大海岸地区劳动力住房联盟执行董事尼克·泰勒说:「我们在租赁住房供应方面处于危机水平。」
sentences.en_text: “We are at a crisis level on the supply of rental housing,” said Nick Taylor, executive director of the Workforce Housing Coalition of the Greater Seacoast.

sentences.cn_text: 泰勒表示,在新罕布什尔州南部城镇缺乏足够经济适用房的情况下,「雇主很难吸引员工,而员工也很难找到住处」。
sentences.en_text: Without enough affordable housing in southern New Hampshire towns, “employers are having a hard time attracting employees, and workers are having a hard time finding a place to live,” Taylor said.

sentences.cn_text: 然而,当地房地产经纪人协会首席执行官瑞安·卡斯尔指出,短期租赁也为游客提供了住房。
sentences.en_text: However, short-term rentals also provide housing for tourists, pointed out Ryan Castle, CEO of a local association of realtors.

sentences.cn_text: 卡斯尔说:「许多工人为旅游业服务,而旅游业也依赖短期入住的游客,所以这是一个循环效应。」
sentences.en_text: “A lot of workers are servicing the tourist industry, and the tourism industry is serviced by those people coming in short term,” Castle said, “and so it’s a cyclical effect.”

sentences.cn_text: 经济适用房政策专家凯伦·霍恩表示,短期租赁本身并非问题的关键。
sentences.en_text: Short-term rentals themselves are not the crux of the issue, said Keren Horn, an expert on affordable housing policy.

sentences.cn_text: 「我认为个人能够出租第二套住房是件好事。
sentences.en_text: “I think individuals being able to rent out their second home is a good thing.

sentences.cn_text: 如果它本就是度假屋,而且闲置着,为什么不能用它赚钱呢?」霍恩说道。
sentences.en_text: If it’s their vacation home anyway, and it’s just empty, why can’t you make money off it?” Horn said.

sentences.cn_text: 然而,当开发商试图建造大规模短期租赁设施——实际上就是酒店——以规避税收和监管时,问题就出现了。
sentences.en_text: Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities — de facto hotels — to bypass taxes and regulations.

sentences.cn_text: 霍恩说:「我认为问题是,一个实际在建酒店却伪装成非酒店的开发商,难道不应该像酒店一样被对待、征税和监管吗?」
sentences.en_text: “I think the question is, shouldn’t a developer who’s really building a hotel, but disguising it as not a hotel, be treated and taxed and regulated like a hotel?” Horn said.

sentences.cn_text: 2018年底,马萨诸塞州州长查理·贝克签署了一项法案,以遏制这些潜在的投资买家。
sentences.en_text: At the end of 2018, Governor Charlie Baker of Massachusetts signed a bill to rein in those potential investor-buyers.

sentences.cn_text: 该法案要求每位租赁房东在州内注册、强制购买保险,并可能在新州税的基础上征收地方税。
sentences.en_text: The bill requires every rental host to register with the state, mandates they carry insurance, and opens the potential for local taxes on top of a new state levy.

sentences.cn_text: 波士顿走得更远,要求租赁者在市检验服务部门注册。
sentences.en_text: Boston took things even further, requiring renters to register with the city’s Inspectional Services Department.

sentences.cn_text: 霍恩表示,类似的登记要求可能会使陷入困境的城市和城镇受益,但「如果我们想改变住房市场,最关键的是我们必须建造更多住房」。
sentences.en_text: Horn said similar registration requirements could benefit struggling cities and towns, but “if we want to make a change in the housing market, the main one is we have to build a lot more.”

sentences.cn_text: 关于新英格兰,以下哪项说法正确?
sentences.en_text: Which of the following is true of New England?

sentences.cn_text: 其住房供应处于极低水平。
sentences.en_text: Its housing supply is at a very low level.

sentences.cn_text: 其社区需要资金支持。
sentences.en_text: Its communities are in need of funding.

sentences.cn_text: 其租赁空置率正在缓慢上升。
sentences.en_text: Its rental vacancy rate is going up slowly.

sentences.cn_text: 其房价受到严格控制。
sentences.en_text: Its home prices are under strict control.

sentences.cn_text: 第二段提到的法案旨在____。
sentences.en_text: The bill mentioned in Paragraph 2 was intended to ____

sentences.cn_text: 遏制短期租赁投机行为。
sentences.en_text: curb short-term rental speculation.

sentences.cn_text: 确保廉价住房的供应。
sentences.en_text: ensure the supply of cheap housing.

sentences.cn_text: 惩罚非法住房交易。
sentences.en_text: punish illegal dealings in housing.

sentences.cn_text: 允许自由的短期租赁市场。
sentences.en_text: allow a free short-term rental market.

sentences.cn_text: 与卡斯尔相比,泰勒更可能支持____。
sentences.en_text: Compared with Castle, Taylor is more likely to support ____

sentences.cn_text: 进一步投资当地旅游业。
sentences.en_text: further investment in local tourism.

sentences.cn_text: 增加经济适用房数量。
sentences.en_text: an increase in affordable housing.

sentences.cn_text: 严格管理房地产经纪人。
sentences.en_text: strict management of real estate agents.

sentences.cn_text: 为短期工提供优惠政策。
sentences.en_text: a favorable policy for short-term workers.

sentences.cn_text: 霍恩在第5段强调了什么?
sentences.en_text: What does Horn emphasize in Paragraph 5?

sentences.cn_text: 升级短期租赁设施的紧迫性。
sentences.en_text: The urgency to upgrade short-term rental facilities.

sentences.cn_text: 当地住房市场的高效运作。
sentences.en_text: The efficient operation of the local housing market.

sentences.cn_text: 阻止开发商逃税的必要性。
sentences.en_text: The necessity to stop developers from evading taxes.

sentences.cn_text: 出租闲置房屋的适当程序。
sentences.en_text: The proper procedures for renting out spare houses.

sentences.cn_text: 霍恩认为实施登记要求是____。
sentences.en_text: Horn holds that imposing registration requirements is ____

sentences.cn_text: 一项不合理的决定。
sentences.en_text: an irrational decision.

sentences.cn_text: 一个不可行的提议。
sentences.en_text: an unfeasible proposal.

sentences.cn_text: 一项不必要的措施。
sentences.en_text: an unnecessary measure.

sentences.cn_text: 一个不充分的解决方案。
sentences.en_text: an inadequate solution.
